source_state: Working tree based on baseline_commit with uncommitted greedy-encoder changes: slice-fed DenseRun::store_range for the untagged q7-q9 bucket shapes, one flat position/tag index in dense_store for the tagged q5-q6 shapes, slice-fed plain literal splitting (BlockSplitter::add_bytes) in the greedy meta-block builder, and the comparison package's lockfile updated to the current mbrotli 0.5.4 dependency set. Decoder sources unchanged from baseline_commit.

corpus_generation: Original eight inputs unchanged: empty, tiny-text, alice29, text-1m, binary-64k, random-64k, random-1m, repeated-1m. Same generator and parameters as decoder-refresh-2026-09-10-080955.
limitations: One WSL2 host; frequency, thermals and host scheduling uncontrolled.
Fixed decoder order; confidence intervals capture sampling variation, not all environmental bias.
C receives known output capacity; Rust Vec APIs grow output during decode; Rust brotli includes 4 KiB I/O adaptation.
Only cold APIs and C-generated standard-window streams; no streaming, reuse or dictionaries. Historical timings are not paired before/after measurements.

Eight benchmark processes ran at once on separate cores and shared the last-level cache, memory bandwidth and the package's turbo budget; absolute timings are below a single-core sweep and latency cases of tens of nanoseconds (empty input) move most. Ratios to C are the comparable quantity.
No builds or other benchmark processes ran on the host during the sweep; AFL campaigns started after it ended.
